title: Honkytonk Highrise-Lux Downtown Apt-Pool-Gym
description:
Welcome to Honkytonk Highrise - Enjoy a comfortable stay in this centrally-located place, walkable to many Nashville destinations! Only a 5 minute walk to Country Music Hall of Fame & Music City Center.  A short 10 minute walk to Bridgestone, The Ryman, and Broadway.  
The airport is a 10 minute drive.

You’ll want for nothing in this cozy apartment equipped with a fully-stocked kitchen and all kinds of amenities for your comfort and enjoyment.  Enjoy your Nashville home away from home!

The space
Enjoy our fully-stocked kitchen and cozy living room space.  Living room couch pulls out to a comfy queen-size bed. Another queen size bed is located in the master bedroom, as well as a well-stocked bathroom and spacious walk-in closet.

Guest access
Guests will have access to a beautiful outdoor pool, dedicated workspaces, pool table, luxury lounge, on-site parking deck, Tesla ride sharing, fitness center, and cycle studio. 

Guests will also enjoy fast Wi-Fi throughout the building, an in-unit washer/dryer, a fully-stocked kitchen, and cozy outdoor patio!

Other things to note
Upon confirmed booking, a detailed guestbook will be emailed to you with complete check-in instructions, house rules, local recommendations, and much much more!!
